items.summary: Improve sentence segmentation and optimize text sanitization
items.fullMessage:
Improve sentence segmentation and optimize text sanitization

- Enhance sentence segmentation and URL/domain boundary handling:
  + Fix sentence terminator suppression after trailing URLs and domain names in TextSegmenter._period_stays_with_previous_token(), distinguishing domain tokens with segment lengths > 2 from dotted acronyms (e.g. U.S.A., B.Sc.).
  + Expand TextSegmenter.looks_like_url_token() to recognize email addresses and common scheme-less URL prefixes (www., http., https., mailto:, ftp.).
  + Tune segmentation thresholds: set fast-first trigger threshold to 120 characters, regular segment maximum length to 200 characters, and punctuation-free intact ceilings to 135 characters (110 for no-space scripts).
  + Accelerate speech text sanitization in sanitize_speech_text() using a precomputed translation table (_SPEECH_SANITIZE_TABLE) with fast-path str.translate() for 1:1 Unicode whitespace and BMP PUA normalization.
